capabilities: drag with the mouse button to scroll notes
scroll in both Edit and Reading modes
extras: README is very short and mostly points at a plugin menu screenshot that was removed; it states the feature is desktop-only because mobile devices already scroll by touch natively.
intentEvidence: Inspired by PDF viewers and similar browser extensions.
motivation: The author was inspired by PDF viewers and similar browser extensions.
problem: Obsidian on desktop has no built-in way to pan long notes by dragging with the mouse, as touch devices and PDF viewers allow.
summary: Desktop-only mouse helper that lets you hold and drag anywhere in a note to scroll, like on a touch device.
